Name: (CP) Maru with Long Beta Hair
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=5]Updated for 1.6![/size]


I really like Maru's 'beta'/early development build design, particularly her poofy long hair~ So I brought the poofy hair onto Maru's final design, updating the shading and colors to match the current art style. Also did some other color tweaks to her character sprites to make the outfits match, and added glasses to them.

Looking for more hair and clothing color options? Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23841/]Maru with Long Beta Hair Customizable Version[/url] mod!


[b]To install Content Patcher version--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy![/font]

Downloads.Description: Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
